body: This could use some examples. Or are we adding those as part of another PR?
OP says this resolves https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10317#issuecomment-2317442832 (among other things) but I don't see that aspect defined here. Where is that defined?

It looks like everything has been addressed with this PR for a bit now. The contents look good to me, thanks for resolving the last two bits in https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10586#issuecomment-2722397769 @josepharhar and adding more detail to the commit message in the OP.

I'll plan on merging this towards the end of next week, provided the one nit I found gets resolved and there are no further substantial reviews.
